concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-pix-web-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured Pix Web Drop-in guide for Sessions/Advanced fields, QR countdown versus payment expiry, Pending qrCode action, refund window and test/live gates.
warnings: Sessions shopperStatement max 140 characters differs from Advanced custom-value under-60 rule.
QR countdown default 15 minutes differs from Advanced payment expiry defaults of 1 hour through Checkout API v71 and 24 hours from v72.
Pending qrCode is not paid status; test offer promotion is simulation.
The Pix.Configuration example is fenced bash with JavaScript-like syntax and labels countdownTime required despite a table default.
